identificationModule.briefTitle: CAR-T Therapy for Relapsed Large B-Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A phase 2 study evaluating an autologous CD19-directed CAR-T therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma. The primary endpoint is overall response rate at three months.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Inhaled mRNA Therapy for Cystic Fibrosis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A first-in-human study of a nebulized mRNA therapy designed to restore CFTR protein function in patients with cystic fibrosis carrying selected mutations. Safety and tolerability are the primary endpoints.
